rules.title: Good cause required for non-renewal of lease (Anti-Eviction Act)
rules.requirement: A landlord of residential rental property may not fail to renew any lease, written or oral, unless the landlord has good cause not to renew. The good causes are those listed for eviction.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords of residential rental properties, other than owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings, motels or hotels, and transient or seasonal units.
rules.exemptions: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings, motels or hotels, and transient or seasonal units.
rules.quoted_span: No landlord of residential rental properties except t hose in owner occupied two or three family dwellings, motels or hotels, transient, or seasonal units may fail to renew any lease, regardless of whether it is written or oral unless they have good cause not to renew the lease.
